name: llm-eval
description: Evaluate LLM outputs against golden examples with tolerance-based scoring. Supports exact match, fuzzy match, numeric tolerance, regex patterns, and JSON structure comparison with configurable pass/fail thresholds.

LLM_EVAL_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD.title: Default Pass Threshold
LLM_EVAL_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD.description: Default minimum score (0.0-1.0) for a test case to pass. Overridden by per-suite or per-case thresholds.

LLM_EVAL_FUZZY_RATIO.title: Default Fuzzy Match Ratio
LLM_EVAL_FUZZY_RATIO.description: Default minimum similarity ratio (0-100) for fuzzy string matching. Uses Levenshtein-based comparison.

LLM_EVAL_NUMERIC_TOLERANCE.title: Default Numeric Tolerance
LLM_EVAL_NUMERIC_TOLERANCE.description: Default tolerance for numeric comparisons, as an absolute value or percentage (e.g., '0.01' or '5%').
